claimCard.canonicalDebunk: On the night of 4-5 August 2026, an explosive device attached to a drone was discovered next to a Ukrainian Antonov Airlines cargo aircraft at Leipzig/Halle Airport. Air traffic was briefly suspended while bomb disposal experts neutralised the device. German Interior Minister Alexander Dobrindt described the incident as a professional 'hybrid threat scenario' involving military-grade explosives and evidence of deliberate sabotage. Due to the seriousness of the incident and the possibility of foreign state involvement, German prosecutors and counterterrorism authorities took over the investigation. Security reporting and US intelligence assessments later pointed to possible Russian links, consistent with previous sabotage operations targeting European aviation and logistics infrastructure. There is no evidence to support the claim that the incident was staged by Ukraine or Western elites.
